This 3-Day Online program can stop your overthinking and teach you to Master your Mind:
Pranayama simply means the act of controlling your energy. Through the practice of pranayama, we learn to enhance and manipulate our energies.
In this session, you will learn Anulom Vilom Pranayama, one of the most powerful breathing techniques to:
• Calm an overactive mind
• Reduce stress and anxiety
• Improve clarity and focus
• Balance the Agya Chakra
• Strengthen intuition and decision-making
